title: Carlin Tunnel proof of concept scan
summary: Jeffrey tells of Carlin Tunnel proof of concept scan, about 2024 at Carlin Tunnel, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, we here here we have the Carlin Tunnel.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey, working with a colleague named Filippo, shows a 2024 scan of a place called the Carlin Tunnel. He presents it as a test, a proof that their scanning method can see what lies underground. They tell it to back up their bigger claim that the same method has found a huge hidden structure beneath the pyramids of Egypt.
